mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN po.state = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success, SUM(CASE WHEN po.state = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fail, SUM(CASE WHEN orr.three_ds_triggered = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS three_ds, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN po.state = 2 THEN po.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_amount FROM t_pay_order po LEFT JOIN t_order_risk_record orr ON orr.pay_order_id = po.pay_order_id WHERE po.account_id = #{accountId} AND po.created_at >= #{startTime} AND po.created_at < #{endTime} AND po.state IN (2, 3)
